overlaps.title: Home vs focused City Selection

features: Featured global discovery and five-tab entry.
Catalog, search, explicit location and availability share the same city source.

image.caption: Retained legacy native variant on the audit checkout, not a pristine baseline binary; 28 Oct 2026, 402×874pt.

features: Approved S04 editorial selection, consistent photos, Coming Soon and guest entry.
Available city opens its city-scoped Hub; no mandatory account or planner.

image.caption: Archived approved native Screen 04; audit capture 28 Oct 2026, 402×874pt. Not a new device acceptance run.

overlaps.overlap: City selection is repeated visually across entry variants, but this is not a second catalog/controller. Home discovery and focused selection have different entry intents.
overlaps.recommendation: KEEP BOTH ENTRY VARIANTS; reuse existing HomeScreen. Decide launch/revisit policy separately.
overlaps.ownerQuestion: For a first launch, should entry be Welcome or Home? For returning travelers, should Home remain the fallback? Confirm city switching with a live draft must preserve the current draft rather than silently replace it.
risks: S01/S02 are not automatically normal launch. Any first-run policy needs its own authorization.
No city activation, draft deletion or tab redesign.
